svg.title: Your skills stay installed; each state has its own working folder
svg.desc: Install the custom plugin and Anthropic Office once for you in Claude Code. Open State-Practice in VS Code. Select prompts slash reconcile dot md, read inputs slash state-practice dot xlsx, write outputs slash state-reconciliation dot xlsx, then check the output in Excel. Keep all actual work outside the downloaded public starter.

g.text: Install once. Work in the state folder.
Custom work skills + Anthropic Office skills • available across your local projects
VS CODE → File → Open Folder → State-Practice
@ selects the saved request. Your chat asks Claude to perform it. Excel checks the result.
Keep work folders separate from the public starter. Preserve inputs; create new outputs.
Concept diagram. Plugin menus and available tools depend on the installed version and workplace policy.
